summary: Long-range active-radar air-to-air missile (izdeliye 180): AESA seeker, dual-pulse motor, conventional fins

guidance_capabilities.note: Explicit execution declaration transcribed from this card's authored guidance field. False means this profile does not enable the capability; it is not evidence of equipment absence. No seeker, control or fitted-link performance is calibrated; launcher updates still use the explicitly idealized native path.

guidance: inertial with midcourse datalink updates, terminal active radar homing (AESA seeker)
warhead: rod, paired rods with shaped-charge elements (the R-77's)

mass_kg.note: no source read gives it: the R-77-1's published 190 kg, wide (a dual-pulse motor and new fins)

length_m.note: no source read gives it: the R-77-1's published 3.71 m

warhead_kg.note: the R-77 and R-77-1's 22.5 kg: the R-77M's own not given

power_up_s.note: no source gives a missile's power-up or power-down time: 1 s for every missile, an engineering assumption so a strike waits for its missiles as a real one does

power_down_s.note: no source gives a missile's power-up or power-down time: 1 s for every missile, an engineering assumption so a strike waits for its missiles as a real one does

explosive_kg.note: a game reference: War Thunder's su_r_77_1 (the R-77-1's) (TGAF-5); no manufacturer or encyclopedia gives the charge

gurney_kms.note: TGAF-5 (TNT/RDX/aluminium, Russian) is not in Cooper's table: as HBX, its nearest composition - an estimate

drag_area_m2.note: the isolated store's CD S below Mach 0.8 at a Reynolds number of 1e7 per metre, built up from its design (hangar storedrag.py: Hoerner's body of revolution 0.00438, its base 0.00156, its fins' friction 0.00330 m^2): an estimate by one method for every store

munk_volume_m3.note: its body's unstable moment across a flow, q x this x sin(2 x angle) (Munk, NACA Report 184): its volume 0.1082 m^3 from its design, times Lamb's k2 - k1 = 0.982 for its fineness 18.5 (hangar storedrag.py): an estimate by one method for every store

side_slope_m2.note: its fins' and base's force across it per radian of crossflow, over the dynamic pressure (hangar storedrag.py: one fin pair's Helmbold slope carried onto the body, slender-body theory's base): an estimate by one method for every store

side_arm_m.note: where that force acts, behind the store's CG (hangar storedrag.py: its fins' quarter chords, its base)
